import sys, json, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/tmp/dev')
from gen import rand_predicate
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
from ref2 import ref2_compile_job

def build(seed, nf, slots, domsize, ntrain, nq, napp, width=4, npred=32):
    rng=random.Random(seed)
    fields=[{'name':f'f{i}','type':rng.choice(['count','id','flag','size','time']),
             'domain':list(range(domsize))} for i in range(nf)]
    cell_doms=[f['domain'] for _ in range(slots) for f in fields]
    total=1
    for d in cell_doms: total*=len(d)
    preds=[rand_predicate(rng, fields, slots) for _ in range(npred)]
    keep=rng.sample(range(total), max(1,total//2))
    train=[]
    for _ in range(ntrain):
        u=rng.choice(keep)
        vals=[]; rem=u
        for c in range(len(cell_doms)-1,-1,-1):
            r=len(cell_doms[c]); vals.append(cell_doms[c][rem%r]); rem//=r
        vals=vals[::-1]
        train.append([list(vals[s*nf:(s+1)*nf]) for s in range(slots)])
    approved=[sorted(rng.sample(range(npred), rng.randint(1,width))) for _ in range(napp)]
    seen=set(); approved=[c for c in approved if not (tuple(c) in seen or seen.add(tuple(c)))]
    queries=[]
    for _ in range(nq):
        cells=slots*nf
        order=list(range(cells)); rng.shuffle(order)
        nfixed=rng.randint(0, min(4, cells-1))
        fixed=[{'ref':[c//nf, fields[c%nf]['name']], 'value': rng.choice(fields[c%nf]['domain'])} for c in order[:nfixed]]
        t=order[nfixed]
        queries.append({'fixed':fixed,'target':[t//nf, fields[t%nf]['name']],
                        'prefix': rng.choice(['','0','1','10','01','9','123','000','1000000','55','0123456','999'])})
    return {'fields':fields,'slots':slots,'predicates':preds,'width':width,'train':train,'approved':approved,'queries':queries}, total

# max-limits batch: 6 jobs, sum universe <= 131072, <=20000 train total, <=256 queries, <=256 approvals
spec=[(8,2,2,5000,64,256),(8,2,2,5000,64,0),(4,1,3,2000,32,0),(4,1,3,2000,32,0),(2,4,2,1000,32,0),(1,1,2,0,32,0)]
jobs=[]; tot=0; train_tot=0; q_tot=0
for i,(nf,slots,dom,nt,nq,na) in enumerate(spec):
    job,total=build(3100+i, nf, slots, dom, nt, nq, na)
    jobs.append(job); tot+=total; train_tot+=nt; q_tot+=nq
print('universe sum',tot,'train',train_tot,'queries',q_tot,'input bytes',len(json.dumps({'jobs':jobs})))
t0=time.time(); outs=[compile_job(j) for j in jobs]; el=time.time()-t0
print(f'engine {el:.2f}s rules {[len(o["rules"]) for o in outs]}')
# cross-check every job against ref2
ok=all(compile_job(j)==ref2_compile_job(j) for j in jobs)
print('all jobs match ref2:', ok)
EOF
